method: Each photograph/panorama listed as visuallyReviewed was opened and inspected in the normal browser. Only observations and links are archived; no source image pixels are stored.
coordinateSystem: Metres, +X east, +Z south; existing shared/data/map.json OSM footprints. Photographic dimensions are interpretation, never survey.

references.creator: Jiří Ryszawy / ČVUT VIC
references.orientationConfidence: high photographic correlation: west return of north core, matched to geolocated September 2023 photosphere by projecting number, north pairs, three-column side openings and adjacent reception wall
facts: Small square windows have a recessed dark frame and individual pale projecting sills.
At least three small pale square covers are visible between window columns on the broad plane at image right.
The grey face has regular panel seams and fine vertical striations. The image does not establish the material composition or a board-formed-concrete manufacturing process.
A thin vertical conductor is held off the facade at the corner.
references.limit: The covers are documented in June 2024, while the September 2023 panorama corroborates the facade identity and does not show those covers. Their metric centres remain interpretation; no placement is yet implemented.

references.creator: Jiří Ryszawy / ČVUT VIC
references.orientationConfidence: north end at image left, west return at image right; matched to geolocated photosphere google-b4-northwest-202309
facts: Paired small windows belong to a broad end panel, with a narrow recessed stair-window strip beside it.
The perpendicular return also has small openings rather than a room-window grid.
The panel faces are slightly stepped in plan and height; the silhouette is not one rectangular slab.

identifiedMapEdge.status: west return of north core; photographic identity correlation, geometry from OSM

references.creator: Jiří Ryszawy / ČVUT VIC
facts: Four vertical glazed lights with narrow brown mullions and nested sash profiles; no horizontal transom in the standard room window.
A pale thin sloping metal sill has a folded down front lip.
Upper and side reveals have real depth, with the upper edge producing a narrow shadow.
The plaster has fine grain; vertical facade strips project rather than being merely painted.
references.appliedTo: building-window-kit construction profile; standard dorm typology explicitly labelled

references.creator: Jiří Ryszawy / ČVUT VIC
references.orientationConfidence: end facade; matching north composition independently verified, but this individual photograph has no geotag
facts: A broad blank panel is beside a deeply recessed band of low wide stair windows.
Grey cladding is separated by regular horizontal and vertical seams with fine vertical striations.
The upper edge has thin flashing; facade conductors have projecting stand-offs.

references.creator: Google Street View
references.orientationConfidence: high: camera north of OSM footprint, heading south
facts: North end has a wide blank eastern panel, a recessed low-wide-window stair strip, and a western core with six pairs of small square windows.
A projecting number 4 sits at the western corner.
Construction activity is visible at ground level in May 2024; temporary containers are not permanent model features.
references.limits: The square covers visible in ČVUT photo 1 were not independently verified on this north plane or the west return. Do not infer exact vent coordinates.

references.dateEvidence: Google footer says Pořízení obrázku: září 2023; contributor card says říjen 2023. These are distinct dates.
references.creator: Bahá’í Praha / Google Maps contributor
references.orientationConfidence: high: camera west of north core; continuous browser navigation from verified north panorama
facts: The projecting number 4, paired north-end windows and adjacent plain reception wall identify the same corner composition as ČVUT photo 2.
The west return has three columns of small square openings, not standard four-light room windows.
A separate plain reception wall with two air-conditioning units is behind this return; it is not an additional dorm-room window grid.
The pale square covers in the June 2024 ČVUT photograph are not visible in this September 2023 view.
references.limits: Contributor panorama location/heading is source metadata, not a geodetic measurement. The September 2023 image predates the June 2024 covers.

references.creator: Seznam.cz / Cyclomedia Technology B.V.
references.orientationConfidence: high: east of the mapped shared Potraviny/R-ko shell
facts: Four small upper barred openings and lower rectangular barred openings are visible.
A round vertical metal flue has joining collars, a raised rain cap and a low protective barred enclosure.
The top wall edge has narrow metal flashing.
The wall is painted with a mural, which is reference-only and is not reproduced.
references.appliedTo: market-detail-kit flue; original established east-face placement retained
references.limits: The actual bar door is not visible. The R-ko POI inside this building is not a verified doorway. Exact collar count, spacing, bracket/grille construction and metric dimensions are interpretation.

references.creator: Google Street View
references.identityConfidence: training-centre place profile and official SH Wiki corroborate location; exact facade-to-OSM footprint mapping still to be verified
facts: The low pale building northwest of the camera is separate from the grey commercial structure on the right/east.
Trees and a van obscure parts of the front, so the complete window and door layout cannot be counted from this view.
references.officialIdentity: Former laundry used by Silicon Hill; Olympijská 1912/2. Wiki page revision 2023-03-22.
references.limits: Do not decorate the neighbouring grey commercial building as the training centre or create an entrance from the place marker.
